{"thought": "I have confirmed that `tomlkit.loads` and `tomlkit.dumps` are available. Now I will construct the test case based on the issue description. The expected output should have a newline after the inline table.", "tool": "run_test", "args": {"source": "import tomlkit

def test_inline_table_newline_after_add():
    v = tomlkit.loads("""[x]\na.b = {}""")
    v["x"]["c"] = 3
    result = tomlkit.dumps(v)
    expected = """[x]\na.b = {}\nc = 3\n"""
    assert result == expected"}}
